title: Kyoto University, NEC and Others Find CrSb Crystal Orientation Changes the Force That Moves Magnetization: A Clue for MRAM Design
excerpt: On September 10, 2026, Kyoto University, NEC and others announced research showing that the force that moves magnetization changes with the crystal orientation of CrSb thin films. We explain why interface symmetry matters, what it means for MRAM, and the limits that should be kept separate from commercialization.
